name: Gumroad
description: Ecommerce: platform for creators to sell digital products, memberships and physical goods, with a REST OAuth API for products, sales, subscribers, licenses and payouts.
access_notes: Anyone with a free Gumroad account can register an OAuth application in settings and, per the official API docs, 'On the application page, click Generate access token' for immediate own-account access; third-party access uses the OAuth2 authorization-code flow (gumroad.com/oauth/authorize) with scoped Bearer tokens. The Verify License endpoint needs no OAuth app.
mcp_notes: Composio has a Gumroad toolkit (OAuth2, 7 tools: get sales, list products, verify license, resource subscriptions, etc.). No official vendor MCP server found on gumroad.com or the antiwork GitHub org (none_found refers to vendor MCP).
uncertainty_notes: API is creator-account-scoped: strong on products/offer-codes/emails CRUD, sales read/refund/ship, subscribers, licenses, payouts — but no purchase/checkout creation, hence medium breadth. Webhook support is via 'Resource subscriptions' (sale, refund, dispute, cancellation events POSTed to your URL) plus the legacy Ping.

evidence.note: Official API reference: register an OAuth application, 'Generate access token' on the app page; REST endpoints for Products, Sales, Subscribers, Licenses, Payouts, Offer codes, and Resource subscriptions (event notifications to your URL).
Help Center: create an application, get client_id/client_secret, OAuth2 authorize at gumroad.com/oauth/authorize; token response is token_type Bearer.
Composio Gumroad toolkit page: OAuth2 auth, 7 tools (Get Sales, List Products, Verify License, subscribe/unsubscribe resource, etc.).
